notes.title: Game release!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Well, the game is out and available for download for free, just for fun. This game was originally planned as a bit of an experiment. I really liked one existing physical card game, and wanted to try to move and adapt it into a digital form. Of course, not just as a copy-paste, but by bringing something of my own, my own idea, my own visuals.

Did it work? Well, if you can download it and play it, then yes, technically it worked. But how well? That's debatable. Because people left a lot of feedback that something is inconvenient, something is unclear, something is wrong and so on. Some of the shortcomings I corrected, but not everything, alas. In any case, you don't have to pay money for the game. If you liked it, fine, if you didn't like it, fine. It's not a $100 bill to please everyone, as smart people say.

As a bonus, I decided to add the possibility to support my efforts with a penny, optionally. The additional content includes the original game project without sound assets, which you can look at, change, finalize, take some developments from there and so on.

Play good games and don't play bad games. Good luck, everyone!
